abstract: Epidermoid cyst of the testis, which is regarded as benign monodermal development of differentiated teratoma and comprises less than 1% of all testicular tumors, was found within the tunica albuginea in a 23-year-old man. Following peroperative histologic confirmation of its benign nature, the cyst was locally removed, thereby avoiding orchiectomy.
abstract_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞は、分化した奇形腫の良性単一胚葉性発生と考えられており、全精巣腫瘍の1%未満を占める。23歳の男性で、白膜内に認められた。術中の組織学的検査で良性であることを確認した後、精巣摘除術を回避するため局所切除を行った。
